newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mixed after rebound.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mixed after rebound.

text.p: March 17 - U.S. stock index futures ended mixed after late rebound in busy trade. Partial recovery in T-bond futures into their close drew good-size dealer, bank buying, shortcovering in June S&P 500. The contract hit buystops above 800.00, near 802.00, as it cleared last Friday's high. Traders noted signs index arbs took advantage of widening premium on rebound.
